Senses.Explanation: Manage to say it means produce the demanded answer in the present exchange. Baizhang Huaihai says the jars will not be broken if the assembly can say it; Gushan Xian judges a reply ‘only half said’; Foyin Liaoyuan makes sitting or surrendering a belt depend on whether the layman can say it.
